text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her declaration of war at the award 
ceremony became a hot topic, and huge 
crowds of spectators flocked to the venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Narita Brian remained calm and 
composed. Paying no heed to outside noise, 
her fighting spirit burned within.
